findings: Updated 10 rows for Ministry of Defence organizations. All .gov.in sites are unreachable from this sandbox (ECONNREFUSED/timeout). Used Wayback Machine CDX API and archived pages to verify URL structures. Results: Row 117 -> mod.gov.in/data-backlog-reserved-vacancies page (vacancy keyword in URL); Row 118/120/122/124/125/126 -> mod.gov.in/dod/appointment (DoD appointment page, confirmed from May 2024 Wayback crawl); Row 123 -> dgqadefence.gov.in/recruitment (confirmed from Aug 2024 Wayback crawl of DGQA homepage showing /recruitment link); Row 127 -> joinindianarmy.nic.in/ retained (entire site IS a recruitment portal requiring login); Row 121 -> desw.gov.in/ retained (no recruitment page exists - site focuses on pensions/ECHS/welfare for ex-servicemen, confirmed via full site map from Dec 2024 Wayback crawl). 9 of 10 rows now have recruitment keywords in the URL. Key finding: mod.gov.in site structure uses /dod/ prefix for Department of Defence sub-pages. Many MoD sub-organizations (DMA, IDS, DGAQA, DGAV, Dir of Standardisation) have NO independent websites and use the parent DoD appointment page.
